items.title: Stuck at 40k
items.summary: Anyone was stuck at 40k a month for a while and finally broke through ? I run ads on meta and have a few TikTok sales. I tried Google search ads, too expensive. If I increase my meta ads budget it goes in learning and my conversion rate becomes shxt. AOV is $75 Conversion rate is around 2.5-3% I spend 10k on Facebook ads I am happy to hear about any advice you may have for me!   submitted by   /u/Bitter_Age_9105 [link]   [comments]
